behaviors.name: Pilot
behaviors.intent: Strafe around the arena in loops, always aiming at the nearest drone, firing a steady stream.
behaviors.source:
behavior Pilot
  on tick
    let t = time * 0.55
    self.position = (sin(t) * 9, 0.8, sin(t * 2) * 6 + 2)
    let e = nearest("enemy")
    if exists(e) then
      look self at (e.position.x, 0.8, e.position.z)
    end
    every 0.11 seconds
      let b = spawn("prefab:prefabs/bolt.prefab.json", self.position + forward(self) * 1.3)
      b.rotation = self.rotation
    end
  end
  on event "kill"
    self.score = self.score + 1
  end
end

behaviors.name: Thrust
behaviors.source:
on tick
  let p = 0.3 + sin(time * 30) * 0.05
  self.scale = (p, 0.25, p)
end

behaviors.name: Waves
behaviors.intent: Send drones in from a random point on the arena edge, keeping the pressure on.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  every 0.45 seconds
    if count("enemy") < 16 then
      let a = random(0, 6.283)
      spawn("prefab:prefabs/drone.prefab.json", (cos(a) * 16, 0.8, sin(a) * 16))
    end
  end
end

behaviors.name: Track
behaviors.intent: Hover high above the arena, leaning toward the player.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  let p = find("Player")
  self.position = lerp(self.position, (p.position.x * 0.4, 20, p.position.z * 0.4 + 16), 0.05)
  look self at (p.position.x * 0.5, 0, p.position.z * 0.5 - 2)
end
